model.name: convnextv2_final
model.note: The model T4.9 chose (results/e15/decision.json), a timm ConvNeXt V2 tiny on 29 classes. Everything under results/e6 and models/e6 is rebuilt when the checkpoint's checksum changes.

config.segmentation_model: not exported: E4 kept no crop (crop_kept is false in configs/e6.json), so no segmentation step is exported or timed

latency.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M
latency.measured: one photo at a time on the CPU, decoded beforehand, from resize to probabilities, by the latency stage run alone

scoring_part.note: The refit's own seed and share (configs/e15.json refit): the part of field_dev groups the thresholds were not fitted on.

config.label: development number, field_dev only

notes: Development numbers on cleaned field_dev only; the model was chosen on field_dev, so they are optimistic. field_test is not scored. Sizes: pytorch 111.6 MB, onnx_dynamic 28.5 MB, onnx_static 28.6 MB (pytorch is its weights alone; the checkpoint file with training state is 334.9 MB). Macro-F1 of pytorch minus each ONNX file: onnx_dynamic +0.0018 [-0.0115, +0.0153]; onnx_static +0.3550 [+0.3215, +0.3909]. Latency on AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M, 4 threads. Class probabilities were computed on cpu (PyTorch) and the CPU (ONNX). Thresholds fitted for the PyTorch model, on the refit's scoring part: pytorch 241/517 answered, 0 sick called healthy; onnx_dynamic 241/517 answered, 0 sick called healthy; onnx_static 0/517 answered, 0 sick called healthy.
